tools.name: analyze_advert
tools.description: Run an AI-only analysis of an advert and get a detailed scoring report. Provide exactly ONE of: `url` (a public image or video URL), `file_path` (a local image/video file to upload), or `text` (ad copy). Optionally pass `brand_url` to improve brand/logo detection. Video is supported and may take a few minutes. Each successful analysis costs 1 credit from your AdTest wallet.

url.description: Public URL of an image or video advert

file_path.description: Local path to an image or video file to upload

stderrTail: adtest-ai-analysis MCP server running on stdio
